Its characteristic polynomial is prod(y+mu_j)-prod(mu_j). A double nonreal root y0 would need sum_j 1/(y0+mu_j)=0, but each term has imaginary part -Im(y0)/|y0+mu_j|^2, all of one sign. Hence the 7-state Jordan block forced at y0 needs a state with at least two successors. This is a consistency fact, not an obstruction: actual PH7 graphs already branch.
